answer_1.quote: We depart from previous approaches to summarizing long discussions by using indicative summaries... our approach clusters discussion units, ... generates concise abstractive summaries... This unsupervised approach to generating indicative summaries of long discussions ...
answer_1.outputs: Hierarchical indicative summaries (table-of-contents style) comprising frame headings and abstractive cluster label subheadings

answer_4.quote: To manually evaluate the quality of the cluster labels, we used a ranking‑based method in which four annotators scored the generated cluster labels...
